name: @pipeworx/mcp-pipedrive

tools.name: pipedrive_list_deals
tools.description: View all deals in your pipeline. Returns deal IDs, titles, values, stages, and owners. Use pipedrive_get_deal for full details on a specific deal.

status.description: Filter by status: open, won, lost, deleted, all_not_deleted (default: all_not_deleted)

tools.name: pipedrive_get_deal
tools.description: Get complete details for a specific deal (by ID). Returns title, value, stage, probability, owner, associated contacts, and timeline.

tools.name: pipedrive_list_persons
tools.description: View all contacts in your CRM. Returns names, email addresses, phone numbers, and associated organizations and deals.

tools.name: pipedrive_get_person
tools.description: Get full contact details by ID. Returns name, emails, phones, organization, associated deals, and custom fields.

tools.name: pipedrive_search
tools.description: Search deals, contacts, organizations, products, or files by keyword. Returns matching records with IDs and basic info.

item_types.description: Comma-separated item types to search: deal, person, organization, product, file (default: all)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pipedrive forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pipedrive pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
